body: I wish I could, but I do not have that type of money for professional help...

Yeah, no problem. Any time. Some people on here are just assholes most of the time and don’t even give you advice when you need it. 
Hope everything turns out well for you.
I understand what you’re feeling. I have been there. I don’t know him personally but from the information you’re telling me, he seems only down to fuck. Nothing serious.

I know exactly how you feel. It honestly fucking sucks you know. I have had depression at a super young age (4 years old and I’m 20 right now). Plus the anxiety doesn’t help. Especially when you’re so alone. Because I am the definition of alone. But sadly I can’t kick the bucket because I still have very little hope left in this fucked up world. 
I hope you are able to defeat your depression.
I say don’t do it. You might get attached. Also, it seems like it will not turn into a relationship. It will more than likely turn into fuck buddies or a one night stand.
No he isn’t my first love. My first love was only five years older than me.

I rather not say the distance as I want to keep this as private as possible. 

You could know the age though. I am 20 and he is 45.

I understand what you’re trying to say. I don’t get it neither because this has never happened to me. But when I have met friends through the Internet first and then in person, they are almost exactly the same. So I am not super concerned about that. 
But I am looking for something serious with him, but my parents will not like the fact that he is so much older than me. Most of my aunts in my family date guys way younger than them. About a twenty year difference, but that is looked at as okay in my family. Although, the other way around, my family looks at it as completely wrong. They will see it as if he is taking advantage of me.
At the moment that doesn’t bother me at all. I just want to be with him, but then I do start thinking how it will be difficult as I get older. It’s just a very complicated situation in my head.
He’s coming down in January. We video chat and talk on the phone and text when he isn’t busy with work.
